subject: Localized quality pathway & demo plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Helena Vogt <hvogt@polaris.ai>, Kenji Saito <ksaito@kairo.jp>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Apr 5, 2027, 13:12 UTC
Subject: Localized quality pathway & demo plan

Helena / Kenji — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we’re all aligned:

Key takeaways from discovery:
- Primary use cases: customer support triage (German, Polish) and knowledge summarization for internal documentation (Japanese).
- Quality bar: human-level intent preservation for triage, <5% factual hallucination on summaries, and correct diacritics/honorific handling for EU/APAC locales.
- Data constraints: staging data available (anonymized snippets) but no PHI; contract team asked about retention and SOC2 (happy to loop in security separately).

Model fit recommendations (shortlist for pilot):
1) rw-infer-7B-q4 (fast, good low-latency for streaming)
2) openx-13B-fp16 (higher base quality; evaluate for Polish and German morphology)
3) ja-special-6B (tight Japanese tokenization + honorifics handling)

Attached: a starter prompt set (polaris_prompt_set_v1.csv) and our initial benchmark summary (euro-apac-benchmark-summary.pdf). The prompt set contains 120 sample prompts per language spanning triage, summarization, and clarifying Q&A.

Concerns we flagged during the call:
- Polish diacritics and compound words: some models drop diacritics under aggressive quantization.
- Japanese keigo (honorifics): we saw consistency issues in previous pilots where models over-used polite forms.
- Latency SLOs: European production latency target is 200ms p50 for short prompts — batching needs careful tuning.

Recommended pilot plan (timeline):
1) Run a focused eval across DE/PL/JA with 150 eval items each (2 weeks) — we’ll report per-language precision/factuality/diacritic metrics.
2) Prompt engineering pass + 2nd eval (1 week).
3) Pilot deployment (staged canary) with telemetry + rollback policy (2–4 weeks).

Ask from you: please confirm priority between (A) support triage first, (B) docs summarization first, or (C) run both in parallel. Once you confirm, we’ll schedule an initial eval run and share a SOW/pilot estimate.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachments: polaris_prompt_set_v1.csv (text/csv), euro-apac-benchmark-summary.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Helena Vogt <hvogt@polaris.ai>, Kenji Saito <ksaito@kairo.jp>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Apr 5, 2027, 13:45 UTC
Subject: Re: Localized quality pathway & demo plan

Helena / Kenji — quick technical add-on to Jasmine’s notes:
- For the rw-infer-7B-q4 candidate we recommend running the DE/PL eval at q4_0 with KV-cache enabled; aggressive q5 caused diacritic loss in our lab runs.
- We will use continuous batching with a 30ms micro-batch window to meet p50 targets while keeping p95 tail reasonable.
- For Japanese, the ja-special-6B will be evaluated with locale-specific tokenization and an additional post-processing pass to normalize honorific forms when requested.

I’ve added a brief eval checklist to the Drive folder (see related links). If Polaris can drop a small anonymized sample (200 rows) into the folder, we’ll queue the run and aim to share the first pass in 10 business days.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao | ML Solutions Engineer
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Helena — putting together the answers and next steps below. Short version: yes, we can meet the April 26 steering committee with the preliminary report if we kick off this week.

Confirmed items and next steps (action items):
1) Polaris uploads: we have the 220-row file — thanks. Aditya’s team will queue the 150-item per-language eval (DE/PL/JA) tomorrow.
2) Timing: initial quantitative report (precision/factuality/diacritics/honorific metrics) by Apr 19; qualitative notes + prompt pass by Apr 23; final summary for steering committee by Apr 26.
3) Pilot estimate: we’ll send an SOW and order-of-magnitude cost for a 6-week pilot by EOD tomorrow (attaching pilot-sow-template.docx).
4) Compliance: Contracts and Security are looped on this thread (Cc). For SOC2 and retention: short note — pilot logs are retained for 90 days by default; long-term retention can be configured per contract. I’ll ask security to provide the standard SOC2 summary and retention options via the Contracts alias.

Requested from Polaris: priority confirmation (you gave DE>PL>JA — noted), and a primary legal contact for procurement to engage with contracts@redwood.ai.

Next internal step: Aditya will run the baseline eval run and I’ll schedule a 30-min checkpoint for Apr 14 to review early signal. Proposed calendar invite will follow.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Jasmine Liu
